title: Light Smoky Ethiopian Chicken Doro Wot
description: A smoky and crumbly Ethiopian dish featuring wholegrain mustard and nigiri-shaping, made with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken pieces and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the wholegrain mustard, berbere spice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Use two spoons to shape the chicken mixture into small nigiri-shaped balls.
Serve the doro wot hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
